name: Orsolya Kovács
bio:
Orsolya's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through racing, but through a passion for engineering and a desire to build things that moved fast. After excelling in technical college, she took an apprenticeship at a local racing parts manufacturer, quickly proving her worth with her meticulous attention to detail and practical problem-solving skills. Her experience there led her to Cadillac Racing, where she thrives on the challenge of fabricating high-performance components.

Orsolya is known for her rigorous standards and her insistence on precision in every aspect of her work. She believes that a single flaw can compromise an entire vehicle, and she refuses to compromise on quality. Her technical expertise is complemented by a surprising understanding of vehicle dynamics, making her a valuable asset in identifying potential weaknesses and proposing innovative solutions. While some might find her demanding, her commitment to excellence is undeniable, and her contributions consistently elevate the team's performance. Orsolya dreams of one day designing her own race car.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Orsolya is of average height with a lean build and focused, intense eyes.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils to a needlepoint before starting any task.
Refuses to use power tools without first performing a visual inspection and reciting a safety mantra in Hungarian.
Insists on listening to classical music while working to maintain focus.
